description: This is a database migration script for creating and dropping tables related to a Global Task Framework in a project, specifically defining 'tasks' and 'task_subscribers' tables with associated indexes and foreign keys.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Creates 'tasks' and 'task_subscribers' tables with indexes and foreign key constraints for the Global Task Framework.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Drops the 'tasks' and 'task_subscribers' tables along with associated indexes and foreign keys.
